annotations.title: Company diligence: domain intel and sanctions in one answer

description: One call for one company domain: site identity, tech stack, email provider and email security, hosting, DNS and registration age, plus a sanctions-list screen (OFAC, EU, UN, UK) of the domain's own name, the label before the first dot. No company register is read. Use when an agent must vet a counterparty's website before dealing with it: one answer with a signed receipt and per-section failures. Public sources only; no private data. Example: domain=stripe.com. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
